persistence.strict_persistent_lead_turn: The earliest turn after which the eventual winner has a strictly positive lead at every remaining boundary; later equality and opponent leads are both forbidden.
persistence.nonlosing_persistence_turn: The earliest turn after which the eventual winner is never behind at any remaining boundary; later equality is allowed but an opponent lead is forbidden.
persistence.last_lead_change_turn: The last turn on which the non-zero leader differs from the most recent prior non-zero leader; equality does not itself name a leader.
persistence.draw_handling: Winner-based persistence is null for draws. Lead changes, equality periods, and final return to equality remain defined.

reversal.definition: current leader at Turn N eventually loses
reversal.denominator: games with a non-tied current leader at Turn N
reversal.draws: Reported separately and retained in the non-tied-leader denominator.
reversal.ties: Turn-N tied games are reported separately and excluded from leader outcome rates.
